versions.subject: Merge PR #5379 from @swachchhanda000 - NodeJS Execution of JavaScript
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\node.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'node.exe'
    - Product: 'Node.js'
selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains: '.js'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\node.exe" OR OriginalFileName="node.exe" OR Product="Node.js" CommandLine="*.js*"
